home.title: KonitFlash — Flashcards that stick
home.description: Official site for the KonitFlash flashcard app. Download CSV decks and learn how to get the most out of it.

hero.description: KonitFlash uses the scientifically validated SM-2 algorithm to compute the optimal review time for every card. Whether you build the deck or import it from CSV — study less, remember longer.

cta.comingSoon: Coming soon to the App Store

features.heading: Six quiet habits the app builds for you

sm2.title: SM-2 spaced repetition
sm2.body: Rate each card Again · Hard · Good · Easy — the algorithm schedules the next review right before you'd forget.

csv.title: CSV import
csv.body: Bring in CSVs exported from NotebookLM and friends. Two columns — front and back — is all it takes.

icloud.title: iCloud sync
icloud.body: Start on iPhone, keep going on Mac. Decks, cards, and review history sync automatically.

flip.title: 3D card flip
flip.body: The little flip animation when you reveal the back. Small delights build the habit.

stats.title: Study stats
stats.body: Streaks, today's review load, and the last seven days of activity — all at a glance.

mac.title: Mac keyboard support
mac.body: Space flips the card, 1–4 rate it. On Mac, studying never breaks flow for the mouse.

decksPreview.heading: CSV decks, ready to go
decksPreview.empty: The first shared deck is on its way.

finalCta.heading: Want to remember today's cards tomorrow?
finalCta.body: Install KonitFlash and build your first deck — a few minutes is all it takes.

decksPage.heading: Shared decks
decksPage.description: Download ready-to-use CSV decks. Import them via "CSV import" in the app and start learning right away.

guidesPage.heading: Guides
guidesPage.description: Learn how to get 200% out of KonitFlash. More guides are on the way.

toeic-basic-500.title: TOEIC Basics (5-card sample)
toeic-basic-500.description: Sample deck for checking the CSV format — two columns, front and back.
